title: Downtown Nashville Condo * River Views! * Parking!
description:
Welcome to our stylish downtown Nashville condo with stunning river views! Walk or Uber to Broadway, Nissan Stadium, Sounds Stadium, and top dining. 

Perfect for live music lovers, foodies, and adventurers. 

After exploring, relax in your well-appointed condo and watch the boats go by. 

Enjoy free parking, pool access, and a riverfront firepit terrace — and did we mention the view? 

Make this your home base for the best of Music City!

The space
Spacious 1BR condo with king bedroom + living room queen sleeper—sleeps 4 comfortably.    Pool plus free covered parking included. 1 mile to Broadway

Guest access
Full condo.
Bedroom, living room, bathroom, kitchen.

Plus common areas of pool, firepit terrace, pet relief areas, laundry.
